label: 다국어 배포 검사
prompt: Fix release.mjs, the gate that promotes an in-memory static-site release. Keep its exported promoteRelease(active, candidate) entry point. candidate has a version like v0.8.2, pages keyed exactly by en, ko, ja, zh, and assets keyed by site-root-relative paths without a leading slash. Every page must contain exactly one and one literal ...; both must match the candidate's three-component version. Trust the generated markup: double quotes, lowercase tags, attributes may appear in either order, and whitespace around the span text is permitted. There is exactly one and one per healthy page. Resolve ./ and ../ against each page directory (/ for en, /ko/, /ja/, /zh/), require both resources to be in the bundle under site-assets/, with a pathname fingerprint that is the first 12 lowercase hex characters of the SHA-256 of that UTF-8 asset. The allowed names are app..js and site..css. Reject external URLs, query strings, absent resources, broken fingerprints, duplicate markers, and missing or unexpected locales. Use v followed by exactly three nonnegative integer components (no extra suffixes). Return {ok:true, active:candidate, errors:[]} only when the entire bundle validates. Otherwise return {ok:false, active, errors:[...]} with at least one helpful error. Neither input may be mutated. This is a local fixture: no deployment or network is needed. Keep the normal entry point and use Node built-ins only. Verify the changes in this workspace and report what you actually ran. You may add executable Node tests where useful.

label: 원자적 거래 재처리
prompt: Fix ledger.mjs without changing its exported applyBatch(snapshot, events) API. snapshot is trusted and contains nextSeq (the next unused integer sequence, starting at 1), balances (own account names to nonnegative integer cents), and applied (the accepted event objects in sequence order). An event is exactly {seq,id,from,to,amount}, with a positive safe integer seq and amount, nonempty string ID, and distinct existing accounts. Accept out-of-order batches but apply events in sequence order. Exact replay of an already applied event or duplicate identical event within the batch is a no-op regardless of object property order. A changed payload for a known ID, a different ID reusing a sequence, a missing sequence, invalid input, insufficient funds, or a recipient balance beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER rejects the whole batch. A malformed event must still be rejected even when its ID matches an old event. Successful return: {ok:true, state:{nextSeq,balances,applied}}. Rejection: {ok:false,state:snapshot,error:<nonempty string>}. Neither snapshot nor events may be mutated on any path. Use Node built-ins only. Verify the changes in this workspace and report what you actually ran. You may add executable Node tests where useful.

label: 증분 빌드 계획
prompt: Fix plan.mjs, a release builder's incremental planner, while preserving export planBuild(graph, cached, targets). graph maps build-step IDs to {input:<string>, deps:[IDs]}; cached maps step IDs to the previous fingerprint; targets is a list of requested step IDs. Validate the entire manifest, including unreachable entries: missing dependency or target, cyclic graph, duplicate deps, or invalid entry fails with {ok:false,error:<nonempty string>} and must not return a partial plan. A graph entry has exactly a string input and an array of nonempty unique dependency IDs. IDs use ordinal JavaScript string ordering. Build only the dependency closure of requested targets. To produce one deterministic dependency-first order, repeatedly choose the alphabetically first ready step among the closure (use JavaScript default string ordering). Fingerprint each step using Node SHA-256, lower-case hex, of UTF-8 JSON.stringify([ownInput, [[dependencyId, dependencyFingerprint], ...]]) where dependency pairs are ID-sorted. Output {ok:true, order, rebuild, fingerprints}; order includes every required step exactly once, rebuild contains only steps whose fingerprint differs from the cache, in that same order, and fingerprints contains only required steps. Dependency array order and target order must not alter the plan. An empty target list has an empty valid plan after manifest validation. Do not mutate inputs. Use Node built-ins only. Verify the changes in this workspace and report what you actually ran. You may add executable Node tests where useful.
